## Validation

- [ ] CATGIS CI passes.

## Risk / rollback

Describe relevant risk and the simplest rollback path.

## Repository hygiene

New development should target `main` through a focused branch and pull request. Do not use historical/disconnected branches as merge sources without first auditing their provenance and unique changes.
